description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PrimitiveOp' for TensorFlow operations backed by a single 'Operation'. It provides methods for accessing the underlying operation, equality checks, and string representation, serving as a superclass for specialized operation classes.

classes.name: PrimitiveOp
classes.description: An abstract base class for TensorFlow operations backed by a single 'Operation'. Provides core functionality for derived operation classes.

methods.name: op
methods.description: Returns the underlying 'Operation' instance associated with this primitive operation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the underlying 'Operation' object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the underlying 'Operation' object; considers objects wrapping the same operation as equal.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the operation, displaying its type and name.

methods.name: PrimitiveOp
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with the provided 'Operation'.
